_notes: Distances from standard sea-distance tables, transit at typical laden service speed for the vessel class (Capesize ~13.5 kn, VLCC/Suezmax ~12.5 kn) plus canal/waiting allowance. 'market' holds the destination's pricing: for index-priced commodities a delivered price differential vs the benchmark; for concentrates the destination smelter's TC ($/dmt) and RCs ($/lb or $/oz payable). Differentials and non-benchmark TC/RCs are ILLUSTRATIVE assumptions to show the arbitrage mechanics, not assessments; all are editable in the app.
